ram-blast-radius--note-1-the-3-5-gb-prob.label: The 3.5 GB problem: boot replays all history into RAM maps, and every read path serves from RAM only. Law: bound what RAM holds, never what queries can see.

ram-blast-radius--block-legend.label: Legend
lines: Rose wire = fills RAM today and never lets go
Amber wire = RAM-only read: trim RAM and this path loses history
Green wire = the fix: disk fallback, bounded RAM
Violet node = holds the RAM · Blue node = blast radius reader

ram-blast-radius--if-we-only-replay-a-wi.description: What breaks when RAM is trimmed naively

callouts.text: Conversation UI cuts off at an arbitrary point. listTranscriptLines reads RAM only — older messages exist on disk but never render.
Event cursors and pending deliveries hold line ids. Evict those lines and live streams + delivery lookups break.
Bound what RAM holds, never what queries can see. Every read path needs a disk fallback before any trimming ships.
The engine already has the pattern: heavy-payload kinds keep payloads on disk (built Aug 9 for transcriptLine). Extend it to the live kinds.
